phases.name: Full run of approved v2 (android)
phases.note: No generation: never pick a photo or press Generate. Find cards by name (order differs by app language, R-029). Language rows: one switch per language (launch --lang <tag>), its cards row and then its tips row; locale reset and read English back at each segment end.

segments.name: Template page: chip on every template, the sheet, Got it, Back, scrolling, pictures, data source
segments.note: One visit to the template page. TC-022 compares each picture with specs/2026-11-25/extracted/recommendation-pic-links.png. TC-019 needs logcat from app start.

segments.name: Add Media 「?」 per template, Got it and Back there
segments.note: Open Add Media with 「Import a Photo」 per card; never pick a photo. Q-1 is filed (DRA262611P0289): a still-missing 「?」 repeats that ticket.

segments.name: Language 1: English, 繁體中文, 简体中文, 日本語, Español (España), 한국어, Deutsch
segments.note: Write the per-language recipe here (android/recipes/) so later segments reuse it.
